design.source: USDA Agricultural Statistics yearbook editions (1940, 1950, 1955, 1961, 1964), 'Number and percentage of farms receiving central-station electric service' tables; 1930 from Census of Agriculture as tabulated in Ag. Statistics 1940 Table 745
design.definition: Farms receiving central-station electric service (REA annual estimates), as a percentage of the Census of Agriculture farm count

uncertainty.note: Published official aggregates; no sampling variance published. REA estimates based on annual surveys.

benchmark.name: Internal consistency of published REA/USDA figures
